h1: Custom Flannel Jackets for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom flannel jackets for your team at Perfect Imprints. Soft, durable, and perfect for branding with your logo.
introHtml: Flannel jackets offer a comfortable, casual look that works well for outdoor events, team uniforms, or corporate giveaways. Made from soft brushed cotton or poly-cotton blends, they provide warmth without bulk. Choose from classic plaid patterns or solid colors, and add your logo via embroidery or screen printing. Ideal for winter promotions or employee gifts.
heroAltText: A group of people wearing custom flannel jackets with embroidered logos in plaid and solid colors
